verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes service, so a no-training or training opt-out commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models. The nearest items are configurable retention (including zero-day retention), transcript redaction, pausing recording and admin data deletion. These are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out or no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
